title: Right bundle branch block
summary: The right bundle branch does not conduct. The right ventricle is activated late, cell to cell.

events.label: Normal until the His bundle
events.caption: The atria, the AV node and the His bundle work normally.
events.ecg: A normal P wave and PR interval.

events.label: Left bundle conducts
events.caption: The impulse goes down the left bundle branch and activates the septum and left ventricle in the normal way. The right bundle branch is blocked.
events.ecg: The first part of the QRS looks normal.

events.label: Right ventricle late
events.caption: The right ventricle is activated late, cell to cell, after the left ventricle.
events.ecg: A late second R wave (R') appears at the end of the QRS.

events.label: Wide QRS
events.caption: Activation finishes much later than normal.
events.ecg: QRS over 120 ms with an rSR' pattern and an inverted T wave.

teaching_points: Right bundle branch block: the right ventricle is activated late and the QRS is wide.
Left ventricular activation is normal, so the first part of the QRS is normal.
It can be a normal variant or a sign of right heart strain or disease.
